title: CJP Protest Video Wall — event record
description: One curated clip. Embedded by youtube_id, never rehosted. The array of these in events.json is the single source of truth.

theme.description: Manual theme tags. Filter UI for these is deferred to a later launch.

graphic_content.description: If true, the tile facade is held behind a click-to-reveal interstitial.

reposted_from.description: youtube_id or URL this clip was reposted from (v2 network seed). Null if original/unknown.

_thumbnail.description: Machine-derived thumbnail URL. Falls back to img.youtube.com convention if absent.

_embeddable.description: videos.list status.embeddable at ingest time (authoritative embeddability).

_caption.description: Whether a caption track exists (not the text).

_region_restriction.description: Geo-block footprint (censorship signal): { allowed?, blocked? } ISO-3166.

_stats.description: Aggregate counts only (no comment text/authors). Latest snapshot; time series lives in stats_snapshots.jsonl.

_footage_cluster_id.description: Derived shared-footage cluster (derive-network.mjs). Connected component over DSV edges.

_reposted_from_inferred.description: Machine-inferred original youtube_id (vs curator-authoritative reposted_from). Never overwrites the human field.

_thumbnail_pdq.description: Perceptual hash of the thumbnail/storyboard (hex) for repost matching. Derived; media itself never stored.
